notes.title: PatchNote 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3]Next 1.1.0 Patch: New Dungeon & Various Enemies Incoming![/h3]
Here are the details for Patch 1.0.3:

· Fixed an issue where enemies could still deal damage even after dying.
· Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor disappeared after pressing ESC in the shop menu.

· The cursor can now be toggled using the Alt key.
· Slight upgrade to player animations.
· Added hit animations and sound effects for the player.

· Reduced room sizes to improve dungeon exploration comfort.

· When in monologue or dialogue mode, pressing Spacebar or the "Continue" button will
now instantly display all text.

· Fireball key changed to F.
Damage increased from 35 → 55.

[h2]New Cards Added![/h2]
Attack Power x2 card has been added to the Epic tier.
HP x2 card has been added to the Epic tier.
